tools.name: acquire_subtree_lease
tools.description: Acquires an exclusive hierarchical wildcard lease (e.g. `src/auth/*` or `crate::billing::*`) with TTL across multi-agent swarms, enforcing bidirectional subtree conflict guards.

tools.name: acquire_symbol_lease
tools.description: Acquires an exclusive short-lived symbol lease with TTL on an FQN across multi-agent swarms to prevent concurrent write collisions.

tools.name: audit_taint_path
tools.description: Traces inter-procedural SSA data-flow taint propagation across call graph G=(V, E) and returns verified sanitizer proof chains with cryptographic TaintAuditCertificate.

tools.name: auto_remediate
tools.description: Deterministic AST self-healing rewriter that automatically closes broken JSX/HTML tags, fixes deep property null accesses to optional chaining (?.), and hoists conditional React hooks.

code.description: Raw source code snippet to deterministically remediate

tools.name: begin_tx
tools.description: Opens a multi-file ACID workspace transaction in-memory with automatic rollback journal.

tools.name: check_safety
tools.description: Deterministic AST invariant safety check (<0.05ms) catching delimiter balance, async mutex across await, div-by-zero, array bounds, unsafe unwraps, ReDoS, JSX tag mismatches, conditional hooks, and client secret leaks.

code.description: Raw code snippet to verify (optional if path is provided)

path.description: Path to the source file to verify on disk

tools.name: commit_tx
tools.description: Validates all staged files across AST invariants and atomically commits to disk if and only if 100% pass.

tools.name: extract_intent_slice
tools.description: Extracts a minimal, high-density AST context slice containing only the target symbol and its direct dependencies up to N degrees of separation.

code.description: Optional raw source code to slice from

path.description: Optional file path or directory on disk

symbol.description: Name of the target symbol/function/component to slice around

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Finds all inbound call sites, imports, and references for a symbol across the entire indexed workspace.

symbol.description: Symbol name to look up references for

tools.name: get_blast_radius
tools.description: Calculates the blast-radius impact of modifying a symbol, identifying direct and transitive dependent files, caller sites, reference counts, and breaking change risk score.

symbol.description: Target symbol to calculate modification blast-radius for

tools.name: hybrid_search
tools.description: Executes sub-millisecond in-memory hybrid AST lexical + quantized HNSW vector search across indexed symbols.

tools.name: index_graph
tools.description: Recursively indexes a directory tree into a cross-file SymbolGraph, linking references and computing token savings.

tools.name: morph_ast
tools.description: Executes deterministic AST transformations, refactorings, and rule remediations (converting unsafe unwraps to ?, hoisting conditional hooks, balancing JSX tags, repairing deep property null accesses) with full post-verification proof.

tools.name: patch_symbol
tools.description: Surgically replaces a named AST symbol (function, struct, component, event handler) with new code within a source file.

symbol.description: Name of the function, struct, class, component, or event handler to replace

tools.name: prepare_context
tools.description: High-throughput compound context pipeline: Combines AST skeletonization, blast-radius calculation, context slicing, and symbol resolution in a single sub-millisecond pass to eliminate multi-step LLM round-trips.

depth.description: Optional dependency traversal depth for blast radius (default: 2)

symbol.description: Optional symbol to calculate blast radius and focused context slice around

target_file.description: Target file to extract skeleton and context from

tools.name: query_cst
tools.description: Parses raw source code into a Lossless Concrete Syntax Tree (CST) with Green/Red nodes, trivia (comments, whitespace), and absolute byte offsets.

code.description: Source code snippet to parse into CST

offset.description: Optional byte offset to query the exact token or syntax node at

tools.name: release_symbol_lease
tools.description: Releases an active symbol lease held by an agent.

tools.name: renew_symbol_lease
tools.description: Renews an active symbol lease heartbeat extension.

tools.name: resolve_symbol
tools.description: Resolves full symbol definition metadata, origin file, byte coordinates, signatures, and doc-comments across module paths.

symbol.description: Name of the symbol to resolve (e.g. AstGuard, UserProfileCard)

tools.name: rollback_tx
tools.description: Rolls back and aborts an active workspace transaction, clearing staged buffers without touching disk.

tools.name: semantic_analyze
tools.description: Executes comprehensive semantic invariant analysis (Rules S1..S5), synthesizes formal mathematical proofs with WP calculus derivations, detects counterexamples, and generates deterministic auto-fixes with optional SARIF v2.1.0 export.

path.description: Optional file path to load source code from

sarif.description: If true, includes full OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 report in the response (default: false)

tools.name: simd_vector_search
tools.description: Executes batch hardware-accelerated (AVX2 256-bit / ARM NEON 128-bit) quantized 8-bit dot-product vector search with zero heap allocations, achieving sub-20µs latency.

corpus.description: Optional list of corpus items to dynamically index and search

query_text.description: Query text to embed and search

query_vector.description: Optional raw 64-dim i8 quantized query vector

top_k.description: Number of nearest neighbors to return (default: 5)

tools.name: skeletonize
tools.description: Surgically extracts an AST skeleton (type signatures, imports, interfaces, collapsed JSX render trees) providing >50-80% context token reduction across Rust, TSX, JSX, Svelte, Astro, Vue, and Python.

tools.name: stage_tx
tools.description: Stages a file modification into the active in-memory ACID transaction buffer.

tools.name: synthesize_contract
tools.description: Proactively projects developer intent into strict type contract scaffolding and safety invariant checklists before code generation.

context.description: Optional surrounding context or existing types

target_path.description: Optional target file path (e.g. src/auth.rs, src/UserCard.tsx)

tools.name: trace_taint_flow
tools.description: Traces cross-file taint and unvalidated external data flows heading toward sensitive sinks (DB queries, filesystem calls, unhandled Option/null returns).

code.description: Optional raw source code snippet to analyze directly without disk access

symbol.description: Optional symbol to scope taint tracking

tools.name: verified_patch
tools.description: High-throughput compound patching pipeline: Atomically executes pre-patch invariant safety verification -> in-memory AST symbol replacement -> post-patch full-file integrity validation -> atomic disk write. Aborts with detailed diagnostics if any safety invariant is violated.

dry_run.description: If true, validates and previews the patch without writing to disk

file_path.description: Target file to surgically patch on disk

language.description: Optional programming language (inferred from file extension if omitted)

new_code.description: New implementation code for the symbol

symbol.description: Name of the function, struct, component, or event handler to patch

tools.name: verify_contract
tools.description: Bidirectionally verifies that generated code satisfies the synthesized architectural contract with zero safety violations and complete signature fidelity.

generated_code.description: Implementation code produced by the AI model

intent.description: Alternative: developer intent string if contract object is not provided

tools.name: verify_occ_token
tools.description: Deterministically checks or commits monotonic Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) version tokens across multi-agent swarms.

commit.description: If true, advances the OCC version counter on match (default: false)

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Executes high-throughput dynamic AST & semantic proof verification on code claims, evaluates assertions with fail-fast tri-state verdicts, and mints cryptographic SHA-256 certificates in sub-0.15ms.

claim.description: ProofClaim JSON object containing claim_id, target_symbol, invariant_name, and assertions

claim_id.description: Optional claim ID shorthand if constructing inline claim

path.description: Optional file path to load source code from
